paraphrase: Critical denial, at the event level, of one governing commission: Jesus did not himself give or promise, to his disciples or to their community (the ekklēsia), the power reported in Matthew 18.17 (to hear a member's case and to treat one who refuses to hear it as a Gentile and tax collector). The source's ground, that the saying belongs to a later period, is not encoded; only its consequence that Jesus did not give the power is the statement. It denies only that power (judgeAsChurch). It says nothing about binding and loosing (Matthew 16.19, 18.18), the keys (16.19), forgiving and retaining sins (John 20.23) or shepherding (John 21.15-17); the promise to build the ekklēsia on the rock (Matthew 16.18), which the source dates with it, names no power given to a disciple and is not part of this statement.
